subject: Provisional backfill and freeze-exception: promotion transition for SRE IC
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Chen <emma.hr@talentnow.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Provisional backfill and freeze-exception: promotion transition for SRE IC

Hi Laura / Marcus —

Quick heads-up: we are planning to formally promote Samir Das (SRE IC, Team: Inference Runtime) to Senior Staff Engineer (manager-of-1 transition) with an effective date of 2027-09-15. This is part of the Q3 technical leadership adjustments I flagged in last week’s sync.

Ask: I need a provisional headcount backfill approved (either open req or temporary contractor) to cover the 1.0 FTE of Samir’s current scope for a minimum of 4 months. We are still within a company hiring freeze for non-critical hires, so this would require a freeze-exception for headcount continuity.

Rationale (short):
- Samir is moving into a manager role with an org-wide responsibility for KV cache and multi-tenant routing; promotion increases scope that cannot be covered by existing coverage without risk to latency SLOs.
- The workload is steady-state and customer-facing; if we lose coverage it will impact two active Dedicated customers (Acme Logistics + one internal pilot).
- Proposed mitigation is a perm backfill for the IC role or a 4–6 month contractor (I favor contractor to speed ramp).

Costs: estimated incremental run-rate ~ $140k/year for perm; contractor estimated at $35k–$45k/month. I attached the promotion packet and a light cost estimate.

Timeline: request decision by 2027-08-04 to start sourcing and not disrupt the September transition.

Action requested:
1) Laura — can you advise if a freeze-exception is likely and what approvals are needed?
2) Marcus — can you confirm the scope to be backfilled and whether a contractor is acceptable interim?
3) Emma — can you provide contractor bandwidth/rates if HR vendor option is used?

Thanks —
Jordan
Director, Product Engineering — Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: promotion_packet.pdf]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional backfill and freeze-exception: promotion transition for SRE IC

Jordan —

Thanks for the context and the packet. Two quick clarifying questions before I route an exception:
1) Is this backfill a one-for-one HC increase, or are you proposing to reallocate an existing (open) headcount?
2) Do you have a clear offboarding / knowledge-transfer timeline for Samir so we can estimate overlap?

If this is a one-for-one request we will need sign-off from Finance (cost owner) and the Talent Committee. The normal timeline for a freeze-exception approval is 7–10 business days if all materials are complete. Given your 8/4 target, please provide the requested clarifications today and I’ll flag this as urgent.

Also cc’ing Soojin to confirm whether People Ops prefers an interim contractor or internal uplift for continuity.

Laura
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional backfill and freeze-exception: promotion transition for SRE IC

Jordan / Laura —

Endorse the request. Scope to backfill:
- Primary: KV cache ownership, latency regressions triage, Dedicated customer SLAs (Acme + pilot).
- Secondary: on-call rotation (1:8), code review throughput for runtime kernels.

Samir will do 2 weeks of paired work and 2 weeks of runbook handover before the 9/15 start. That gives a 4-week overlap window.

I prefer a contractor for speed — we can get someone ramped and then convert to perm if needed. I’ll approve up to $45k/month for a contractor for the trial period; if conversion to perm is required we’ll revisit HC allocation.

Attachment: interim_contractor_proposal.docx (I put rough role description + preferred interview panel).

-Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime
From: Emma Chen <emma.hr@talentnow.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T13:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional backfill and freeze-exception: promotion transition for SRE IC

Hi all —

We have a contractor candidate (JDoe) who matches the KV/cache profile and has recent Dedicated infra experience (resume attached). Rate proposed: $42k/month (W2 contractor equivalent), available start: 2027-08-15. We can run an expedited two-step technical screen and an SLT reference check within 5 business days.

Attached: candidate_resume_jdoe.pdf. If you confirm, I will kick off the screening and provide a short list for Marcus’s panel.

Best,
Emma Chen
Principal Recruiter — TalentNow (vendor)
[Attachment: candidate_resume_jdoe.pdf]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Emma Chen <emma.hr@talentnow.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional backfill and freeze-exception: promotion transition for SRE IC

Thanks everyone — summarizing and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Decision summary:
- Marcus approved contractor route up to $45k/month for an interim (2027-08-15 start target).
- Laura will file a formal freeze-exception request with Finance today and route to the Talent Committee; she indicated an expedited 7-day turnaround is possible if materials are complete.
- Emma will run the expedited screen for JDoe; Marcus to schedule panel for 2027-08-05.

Action items:
- Laura: submit freeze-exception (HR-3421) and ping Finance for sign-off.
- Emma: start the screening and share candidate availability.
- Marcus: confirm interview panel and prepare a short tech test.
- Jordan: I will prepare an overlap/onboarding plan and budget note (deliverable: onboarding plan doc) and update the related Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-3421.

Attach: I’ve included the promotion packet and Marcus’s contractor proposal in the thread for record. Once we have Finance sign-off we’ll issue a 90-day contractor PO and begin the engagement.

Thanks —
Jordan
Director, Product Engineering — Inference
[Attachment: promotion_packet.pdf][Attachment: interim_contractor_proposal.docx]
